g1-implement.title: Gate 1 — trend measurement (B2 evidence gate (a)): implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer. DELIVERABLES: .agent-work/issue-310/TRENDS.md, .agent-work/issue-310/trends/measure_surface.py, .agent-work/issue-310/trends/trends.json, .agent-work/issue-310/trends/panel.json. READ .agent-work/issue-310/PRE_REGISTRATION.md FIRST - it is committed BEFORE this instrument exists, it fixes the bin definitions, hypotheses H1/H2/H3, the outcome-selection table and the void criteria, and it is BINDING. (1) CENSUS: walk every commit touching skills/ via git rev-list; NO checkout - git ls-tree -r --long gives blob sizes directly and git cat-file --batch gives content. Union in the off-line baseline revisions BY TAG (baseline/304-trend-snapshot, baseline/304-g2-approve): they are NOT ancestors of main because #304 squash-merged, and a bare sha is GC-eligible while a tag is not. (2) TWO SERIES, NEVER ONE LABEL: the bare term always-loaded is BANNED. Emit NARROW-ALWAYS-LOADED (skills/*/SKILL.md only - the #304 series definition and the verdict PRIMARY number) and WIDE-ALWAYS-LOADED (SKILL.md plus the references/ tokens that SKILL.md names, resolved role-locally then via that commit's own SKILL_REFERENCE_BUNDLES in scripts/install_constellation.py) as separate columns the script NEVER sums. Conditionally-loaded = templates/, scripts/, unnamed references/. Publish the recombination arithmetic. (3) BLOCKING BASELINE REPRODUCTION: reproduce TREND_SNAPSHOT section 1 at tag baseline/304-trend-snapshot (19 SKILL.md, 15831 words, 100 files, 63681 words) or the series is VOID. Also re-derive the baseline at 5d2585b (the merged form) and report the delta between the two - that delta is itself a finding about what squash-merge does to a published baseline. (4) GROSS, NEVER NET: per interval emit gross-added and gross-deleted SEPARATELY, per bin. Gate (a) asks whether deletion keeps up with growth, so growth must be measured directly, not inferred from endpoint differences. A net-only row is a defect. (5) TEST H1 ACROSS ALL ROWS: do deletions land on the conditionally-loaded bin rather than the always-loaded one? The one deletion event documented with exact arithmetic (#304, 172 words) landed entirely in templates/. This is the likeliest decisive finding for gate (a). (6) IS A TREND EVEN COMPUTABLE? Required finding, not optional: state n, the interval in commits AND days, and the smallest change the instrument can distinguish from routine edit churn. Report that n is 2 OR 3 and WHY it is ambiguous (the baseline is not an ancestor of main; whether #304's own squash-merge 5d2585b counts is a judgement call). Do NOT pick one silently. (7) ROLE COUNT 19, _shared EXCLUDED per install_constellation.py:245 (TREND_SNAPSHOT section 2 lists it as a 20th role - a defect, filed as #411). Separate corpus change from roles ENTERING or LEAVING the window; a role's death is an org change and must NEVER read as deletion pressure. Lineage is hand-authored data - say so where a reader sees it, not in an appendix. (8) Section 3's re-run has no direct analogue: define it as the enumerated deletion-event set in the window, WHICH MAY BE EMPTY, count asserted. An empty set is a complete reportable result. (9) panel.json = a small pre-registered set of hand-justified revisions used ONLY as the interpretation/reporting layer over the census, never as the measurement. Do NOT rebuild #307's instruments; reuse fingerprint_global_corpus.py digest/byte conventions and state in writing why the run drivers cannot be reused. Do NOT invent a threshold. Do NOT decide the break. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g1-review.title: Gate 1 — trend measurement: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill templates/REVIEWER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-reviewer. THE REVIEWER PRIMARY AND NON-NEGOTIABLE JOB: HAND-RECOMPUTE at least 2 panel revisions using git show / git ls-tree DIRECTLY, WITHOUT RUNNING THE INSTRUMENT, and compare. A 184-row census cannot be hand-audited, so its correctness rests on the walker being right; the baseline reproduction is ONE external oracle and hand-recomputation is the second. If the hand figures disagree with the instrument the series is VOID and the disagreement is REPORTED - never resolved by re-running the instrument until it agrees. Second: run the instrument twice at the same HEAD and confirm byte-identical output (non-determinism voids the series). Third: confirm the bare term always-loaded appears NOWHERE unprefixed, that NARROW and WIDE are never summed, and that gross-add/gross-delete are reported separately rather than netted. Fourth: confirm every enumeration asserts its count and every number names its revision or tag. Wait for and integrate the returned REVIEW_RESULT.

g2-competence.title: Gate 2 — role-competence evidence (B2 evidence gate (b)) [REASONING GATE]
g2-competence.imperative: REASONING GATE - no crew. Crew-waiver reason: the deliverable is a diagnosis over run artifacts already held in context, and commander-core.md is explicit that a crew on a pure design note is shallower, not safer. DELIVERABLE: .agent-work/issue-310/COMPETENCE.md. OPEN WITH THIS, NOT A FOOTNOTE: gate (b) has n = 0 - not weak evidence, NO evidence. Every refresh/cold-start relaunch in this epic held the FULL monolith, so those runs hold the always-loaded surface CONSTANT. The defect is not a missing control arm - THE TREATMENT WAS NEVER VARIED. Those instances bound Assumption 1 (artifacts carry state between steps) and contribute ZERO to the kernel-vs-monolith comparison. The verdict is FORBIDDEN from entering any relaunch count in the (b) column. Then WITHDRAW the overstated claim that a competence arm is impossible. An ABLATION arm - run one representative mid-spine step with sections of today's monolith WITHHELD versus full - varies the treatment and requires ZERO authoring of a decomposition. Record the CONCRETE cost estimate (which role, which mid-spine step, both arms, run count, disposal) and the reason it was declined (RUNWAY, not impossibility) so the decline is ATTRIBUTABLE rather than asserted-impossible. File the arm design as an issue. Report any Assumption-1 observations separately and clearly labelled as bearing on Assumption 1 ONLY, count asserted, ambiguous instances reported rather than dropped. Attest c1.

g3-verdict.title: Gate 3 — the B2 evidence packet for Tommy [REASONING GATE]
g3-verdict.imperative: REASONING GATE for authoring PLUS ONE COLD READ. The crew waiver is PARTIALLY WITHDRAWN: this run's only real failure mode is in SYNTHESIS, not inputs, so a crew on the measurement and none on the verdict is backwards. Author the packet yourself, then dispatch ONE cold reader whose entire brief is the single question: which of the outcomes does this select, on what number, at what revision? If the reader cannot answer in one sentence, this gate BLOCKS. DELIVERABLE: .agent-work/issue-310/B2_GATE_EVIDENCE.md - the artifact Tommy reads. It MUST: (1) open with limitations, not bury them; (2) name the AXIS measured - the commander is already split on the MODE axis (1e8043a/#107) and B2 proposes the CONTENT axis - and explicitly refuse BOTH the already-satisfied and the unstarted-monolith readings; (3) state that break-proceeds is FORECLOSED because gate (b) is unrun and the gates are conjunctive, so the three-outcome frame RESOLVES TO A TWO-WAY CALL, then declare exactly ONE outcome on a single machine-readable 'SELECTED-OUTCOME: ' line; (4) carry the pre-registered selection table from PRE_REGISTRATION.md and say which ROW fired; (5) hand BOTH open choices to Tommy on their own lines - 'THRESHOLD-CHOICE-HANDED-UP: Tommy' and 'UNIT-CHOICE-HANDED-UP: Tommy'. THE UNIT FINDING IS A NAMED FINDING WITH ITS REVERSAL TABLE, not a footnote: the same corpus produces OPPOSITE role orderings depending on unit (docent 1st by lines / 5th by bytes; admiral 4th by lines / 1st by bytes), and curate_corpus.py already mixes three units in one file (SKILL_WORD_TARGET in words, SKILL_LINE_HARD_FLAG in lines, this run's bins in bytes) with no stated relationship. Asking Tommy for a threshold without asking for the unit hands him an unanswerable question; (6) report GATE-B-N: 0; (7) carry #307's two bounds intact - it measures PLACEMENT not DECOMPOSITION, and its manipulation was 8 days and +31 files, not #304 alone; (8) offer curate_corpus.py's SKILL_WORD_TARGET=400 and SKILL_LINE_HARD_FLAG=500 as the corpus's ONLY in-tree size line, EXPLICITLY OFFERED AND NOT ADOPTED, stating why they cannot simply be adopted (they govern SKILL.md body size, not the always-loaded ROLE SURFACE B2 asks about). GUARD THE VERDICT AGAINST ITS OWN RIGOR: a mechanically reproducible census must NOT read as though it settled a gate whose threshold does not exist. Do NOT rule. Attest c1.
